programme.title: Bachelor of Science (Honours) Scheme in Computing and AI (Computer Science / Enterprise Information Systems)
programme.degree: BSc (Hons) in Computer Science via scheme JS3868, 4 years, Sept 2027 entry
programme.how_found: Programme page (international tab) + PolyU non-local admissions pages (English, general entrance requirements, 2027/28 tuition) + undergraduate scholarships page.
programme.notes: Common Year One; award chosen within the scheme. Non-local interview online, from October.

english.quote: An overall band score of 6.0 or above in one sitting
english.notes: IELTS (Academic); university-wide for non-local applicants 'unless otherwise specified by the individual programme' (the JS3868 page specifies nothing else). No per-section minimum. Test within 2 years before commencement; IELTS Online/One Skill Retake not accepted.

value.description: No GPA threshold; general entrance requirement for international qualifications: GCE/International A-Level Grade B or above in 3 AL subjects; IB: successful applicants typically scored 32+/45 (a past-cycle figure, not a minimum; predicted 30+ may be interviewed); country-specific requirements for other qualifications.

gpa.quote: GCE A-Level / International A-Level subjects with Grade B or above in 3 AL subjects

deadline.notes: Programme page 'Application Deadline' block for Sept 2027 entry; the same date is listed for Non-JUPAS Year 1. Timezone not stated (Hong Kong). The admissions overview also mentions early/main/extended rounds ('Extended Round Application Deadline (for international students only)'), but their dates were not in the served text.

value.population: non-local students, full-time government-funded Bachelor's Degree programmes

tuition.quote: HK$240,000 (approximately US$30,770) per academic year payable in two equal instalments before the start of the first and second semesters of the academic year.
tuition.notes: Preceded by 'The following tuition fee is charged for full-time government-funded Bachelor's Degree programmes in the 2027/28 academic year:'. JS3868 is 'Government-Funded'. Initial fee HK$20,000 on acceptance (part of the first-semester fee).

value.name: Cultural Ambassador Scholarship for Non-Local Students

scholarship_exists.quote: These scholarships are available to both local and non-local students
scholarship_exists.notes: 26 undergraduate scholarships listed; merit-based admission scholarships need no separate application. Example for non-local students: 'Cultural Ambassador Scholarship for Non-Local Students' - 'Renewable scholarship of up to HK$60,000 per year', automatic consideration. Competitive; intake year not stated on the listing.

scholarship_international.quote: Cultural Ambassador Scholarship for Non-Local Students
scholarship_international.notes: Open to non-local applicants with IB, A-Level/IAL or other international qualifications. PARTIAL (up to HK$60,000/year against HK$240,000 tuition).
